title: Levels and rules
subtitle: Define how customers move up levels and which rules apply to the whole merchant network.

niveles.descripcion: Calculated from redeemed purchases. Each level starts where the previous one ends.

combinacion.descripcion: Discount and Flash Promo do not stack. At checkout the one with the biggest saving applies.

ventana_anulacion_min.descripcion: Time a merchant has to void an already charged redemption.

descuento_max_pct.descripcion: Promotions above this cap do not pass the automatic review.

recarga_minima.descripcion: Lowest amount a merchant can top up.

moderacion_previa.descripcion: Every new promotion is reviewed before it goes live.

compras_mes_mantener.titulo: Monthly purchases to keep a level
compras_mes_mantener.descripcion: Redeemed purchases per month that avoid dropping a level.

dias_baja_nivel.descripcion: Days without meeting the minimum purchases before dropping a level.

puja_minima.descripcion: Lowest daily amount that can be bid for a boost.

qr_vigencia_seg.descripcion: Seconds the redemption QR code lasts before it renews.

previa.flash: With a −{pct}% Flash Promo, a {nivel} customer pays {precio}:

publicar.detalle: {n} changes · apply from the next redemption
publicar.confirmarTexto: A new version with {n} changes will be created and take effect immediately for the whole network. It will be recorded in the Audit log.

restaurar.texto: A new version with the chosen content will be created and take effect immediately for the whole network.
restaurar.textoConBorrador: A new version with the chosen content will be created and take effect immediately for the whole network. Unpublished changes will be discarded.

error.titulo: We could not load the rules
error.texto: Check your connection and try again.

errors.hastaMayor: Must be greater than the previous level's cap
